title: Another Site Update
content:
It's time for another site update, and this one isn't as big on the frontend. however, on the backend things are getting interesting. i've spun up a cdn and now this is where posts come from! that means no more whole-site updates for some blog posts yay!
the main reason i even did a cdn, though, is because of some future plans. if you look under the "Creations" tab, you will see two greyed out buttons. the major one is the "Ambrosia Shared Universe Project", because that's gonna be a whole thing. my own universe of rules, lore, characters, planets, history, and more! instead of relying on something like Fandom, i will be creating the wiki myself. i have no timeline on when it's going to be ready to see, but it's a project more on the distant end.
my end goal is to make a universe that could reasonably exist within the bounds of some other furry or anthro-based universes i like, such as Echo, Undertale, Deltarune, Lust Shards, and more. think of it as a sort of headcanon bridge between them and my own thing as well. here's a little sneak peek at something from the universe of mine.

the Earth is now in a post-human state due to the extinction of said humans. the suspected reason for extinction is an airborne protein that may cause death in seconds, specialized on the likes of humans and great apes. the anthros are different enough that they are not affected by the protein, which has by this point become spread through the whole atmosphere. the attack point and strategy for this protein is unknown, and it's really only assumed that it is the cause of primate extinction, because it's missing in human records entirely, and it's impossible to know if it was created synthetically or naturally. whether or not it even caused the extinction is currently a guess at this point, and there's no real way to go any further with it. this extinction event has gotten the name "The Primal Filter"

and here's another interesting piece of lore. in the Ambrosia Universe, the Fermi Paradox was really only a human thing. it turns out that humans were just looking in the wrong ways, like looking at an unpolarized LCD through a polarizing film turned the wrong way

As of August 2026, the whole CDN thing has been reverted. i just didn't like how it felt tbh.
